claims.statement: Tom Allen lost to Mike McCoole in eight rounds and seventeen minutes in St. Louis, with no year given (OCR prints the rounds as '¢igit').
claims.excerpt: I whipped him in ¢igit rounds and seventeen minutes.

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Mike McCoole in forty minutes in St. Louis in 1875 (printed as 1575).
claims.excerpt: when 1 met Allen again in 8. Louis. 1 lost that battie in forty minutes
